title: Warn New Todos
summary: A Claude Code hook that reports to-do and fix-me marker comments the agent just added, so unfinished work gets finished or called out.
description: An agent in a hurry may leave a marker comment instead of doing the hard part. Once a change is saved, this PostToolUse hook compares the text that went in with the text that came out and lists any to-do or fix-me lines that are new.
Markers already present are not counted when an edit only moves them. Whole-file writes list every marker in the content, since the old text is not available.
useWhen: Catch placeholders left in finished code
Audit agent output without reading every diff
Keep a project free of new fix-me notes
Make unfinished work visible in the session

hook.command:
node -e "process.on('uncaughtException',()=>process.exit(0));let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)||{}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const f=String(i.file_path||'');const fs=require('fs');const rx=new RegExp('(^|[^A-Za-z])(TO'+'DO|FIX'+'ME)([^A-Za-z]|)');const pick=s=>String(s||'').split('
').filter(l=>rx.test(' '+l+' '));const edits=Array.isArray(i.edits)?i.edits:[i];const found=[];edits.forEach(x=>{const old=pick(x.old_string).map(l=>l.trim());pick(x.new_string||x.content).forEach(l=>{if(!old.includes(l.trim()))found.push(l.trim().slice(0,100))})});if(found.length){console.error('You added '+found.length+' to-do or fix-me marker(s) in '+(f||'a file')+':
'+found.slice(0,5).join('
')+'
Finish the work now, or tell the user what is left undone and why.');process.exit(2)}process.exit(0)})"

example.result: The agent leaves a marker for the token expiry. The hook lists it, and the agent adds the expiry check or asks you.

faq.question: Does it detect lowercase markers?
faq.answer: No. Only the uppercase words as whole words are matched, which avoids hits in ordinary prose.

faq.question: Can it block the edit?
faq.answer: It runs after the edit, so the file is already saved. The message just sends the agent back to the lines.

access: Reads the text of each edit from the event
